defects_argued.quote: The challenge in the present petition is similar to a batch of petitions wherein, inter alia, the impugned notifications were challenged.

defects_argued.note: missed reply and hearing due to oversight by previous consultant
defects_argued.quote: The reason given by the Petitioner is that the same were missed due to an inadvertent oversight by the previous consultant and the Petitioner itself did not have any access to the GST Portal, except through the consultant.

outcome.quote: The impugned order is accordingly set aside, subject to payment of Rs. 10,000/- as costs which goes to the Sales Tax Bar Association.
